verdict.rationale: mise documents its own environment separation through development, test, and production config overlays. It also offers optional task sandboxing that restricts what a task can read, write, or reach (off by default, Linux/macOS only), and `--dry-run` previews for bootstrap changes. Each of these is only a single thin mention, so they approximate a sandbox rather than demonstrate an isolated test environment that keeps production data safe. Missing for 10: documented isolation of test data from production data, detail on how overlays are selected and enforced, sandboxing that is on by default or cross-platform, an agent-oriented sandbox workflow, and hands-on corroboration.
